configuration_slice.XDP: native linear single-buffer, non-AF_XDP, no packet merge, single FIB redirect to fixed B or eligible local UDP PASS subset

identity_and_events.generation: g=(pool instance/epoch, physical page or valid anonymous page id, current source ownership episode)

join.meaning: fresh allocator page successfully joins source after A mapping/setup; may remain unused in alloc cache

allocation_round.meaning: source alloc returns page to driver; repeated cache/ring allocation stays same g

frame_return.meaning: one consumer reference returned, possibly deferred in XDP frame bulk; not necessarily last pp reference

recycle.meaning: last logical pp reference with page_ref=1 and non-pfmemalloc page becomes cache/ring supply

source_exit.meaning: A unmap/release accounting/pp info clear/put_page; ends g but need not physically free buddy page if another normal reference remains

identity_and_events.same_PFN_after_exit: new g, never count as reuse of old mapping permission
identity_and_events.target_config_change: new mapping episode even if source g is unchanged

only when alloc cache empty; consume ring, reject NUMA mismatch, batch into cache, return last filled page
only after cache/ring cannot supply; batch allocate/map/join/cache then take last successful page
all consumer and driver bias responsibilities must end before recycle; logical last does not require stored pp_ref value zero
missing threshold and enabled gate, NUMA update, free small old-WQE batch before allocating corresponding replacement batch

normal_conditions: stable source NAPI/NUMA and open B config
actual original packets selected by FIB go to same B
B consumer return precedes remaining driver bias release
p is last successful direct cache push in a normal old-WQE refill batch
event_order: g alloc p for first RX packet
actual B map attempt/SQ acceptance
real B CQ and frame bulk reference return
RX refill releases old WQE and remaining driver bias
last-ref p pushed into available direct alloc cache
same refill immediately allocates from LIFO cache p
new actual packet routes B in next allocation round

not_proven: positive net CPU or RAM benefit

event_order: p allocated and consumed by B or eligible local UDP

driver bias drain leaves consumer pp reference

normal_slices.what_is_proven: source affinity/NUMA changes have a concrete normal trigger and can end old g

other_true_exit_branches.reason: ordinary page ref above recycle condition or pfmemalloc
other_true_exit_branches.selected_workflow_limit: branch exists, but extra B cache ref is not stock O0; redirect source comments page-ref=1 at XD:328; actual occurrence not established

other_true_exit_branches.reason: pool destroy scrubs cache/ring and drains final fragments
other_true_exit_branches.selected_workflow_limit: normal queue teardown, not steady-state per-packet physical free; outstanding consumer pages return later

a.meaning: actual source alloc rounds for p within g
a.not: source join count or incoming packet total

r_try.not: FIB decision, redirect statistic or batch ndo call count

r_map_ok.not: SQ accepted; SQ failure unmaps in XD:911-922

r_accept.meaning: successful per-frame submission with FIFO ownership and nxmit increment

r_CQ_reclaim.meaning: FRAME packet cleanup selected through actual CQ progress
r_CQ_reclaim.not: cqes counter or necessarily successful payload delivery; error CQ opcode preserved

r_stop_cleanup.meaning: residual packet cleanup outside normal CQ with NULL CQ context
r_stop_cleanup.not: normal CQ completion; valid device drain separately required

r_pp_return.meaning: actual per-reference page_pool return after frame bulk flush
r_pp_return.not: each CQ, whole-page recycle, source exit or buddy free

r_counters.inequality: For fully matched join-started event window: 0 <= r_CQ_reclaim <= r_accept <= r_map_ok <= r_try; stop cleanup separate
r_counters.window_censoring: missing join/earlier accept can create carry-in; do not force inequalities or fill missing matches
r_counters.repeat_opportunity_upper_bound: at most max(r_try-1,0) later B attempts; useful persistence can be lower due first-map failure/K/T/config changes
r_counters.within_allocation_multiple_packet_repeat: excluded by frozen driver config, not used as positive example
r_counters.future_information: all r are retrospective descriptive counters, never free online future inputs

bounds_and_limits.source_generation_reuse_upper_bound_from: none; same g may recycle repeatedly until actual exit
bounds_and_limits.finite_observation_window_bound: actual attempts bounded by matched external original B packet work and actual alloc rounds in selected slice
bounds_and_limits.pool_size_meaning: return ring capacity only, not total source-owned/consumer/RX pages cap
bounds_and_limits.full_memory_benefit: not inferred; stock O0 also has no idle B pin
bounds_and_limits.K_coverage: unknown; no artificial relation to source total pages
bounds_and_limits.candidate_feedback: Q or changed return can change actual cache/ring contents, replacement allocation and future PFNs; O0 opportunity trace is not candidate closed-loop execution

value_changing_evidence_gap.input: finite named workload/config record matching source g join/actual alloc/recycle/true exit reasons with B attempt/accept/CQ or cleanup; actual XDP/RQ stride, ring capacity and NAPI/NUMA identity
value_changing_evidence_gap.root_pairs: same backend attributable O0 map/unmap CPU costs, independently handled by root/other seat
value_changing_evidence_gap.advance_if: real cross-recycle B opportunity has scale with capacity/exit/service headroom; only supports bounded integration-value verification
value_changing_evidence_gap.restrict_if: most actual g use B once, true exits frequent, or consumer/Q/capacity violates service/resource requirements; restrict named deployment/version only
